title: Your route to 2027
subtitle: five stops, one you — let's drive

stops.reason: Little evidence of cloud or distributed systems work.
stops.recommendation: Ship a small distributed service and deploy it to the cloud end-to-end.

stops.reason: Schemas stayed shallow; no advanced querying surfaced.
stops.recommendation: Design a real schema, then push it with advanced SQL and a NoSQL twist.

stops.reason: Security thinking was implicit, never demonstrated.
stops.recommendation: Threat-model one of your own apps and patch what you find.
Write the docs your future teammate will thank you for.

stops.reason: Layered networking concepts were lightly evidenced.
stops.recommendation: Wire up the layers — build a tiny networked app from sockets up.
